brief:
An Israeli mathematics lecturer at Bar-Ilan University has been charged over a plan to kill hundreds of Palestinians and force mass expulsions, Middle East Eye reported. The lecturer allegedly intended to recruit 72 Jewish attackers armed with weapons to carry out the scheme.

Details of the alleged plot's scope, timeline, and current status of the investigation remain unclear from available reporting.

title: Israeli lecturer charged with plotting mass Palestinian killings
